_concepto: Mini historia lineal, hecha con el método nuevo: EL GUION DE VOZ SE ESCRIBIÓ PRIMERO como historia completa (un farero sube a cambiar la lámpara en plena tormenta; no enciende; la ajusta a ciegas; arranca; el haz barre el mar) y cada plano se diseñó DESPUÉS para ilustrar exactamente su línea. Una persona, un lugar, un objetivo físico que un chico de doce entiende. Sin cara (capucha de lluvia, manos, espaldas), noche + lluvia + niebla como entorno que perdona, doce planos sueltos sin cadenas, duraciones variables por toma.
_metodo: Regla nueva tras EL DRON DEL VOLCÁN: la voz en off es la columna vertebral. Si una línea no entra en su ventana, se reescribe COMPLETA manteniendo el sentido de la historia — nunca se recorta hasta dejarla críptica. Pablo (la voz) corre a ~10,5 caracteres por segundo reales con sus pausas: las líneas están escritas para ese ritmo, no para los 17 cps teóricos.
estilo_imagen: Photorealistic cinematic footage at an old stone lighthouse in a violent night storm, shot on a full-frame camera. Hard rain streaking through every light source, sea spray and fog, deep blacks. Warm tungsten glow from the lamp room against cold blue lightning. Wet stone and brass textures, film grain, handheld weight.
estilo_video: Photorealistic cinematic footage at a lighthouse in a night storm, vertical 9:16. Rain, wind, spray.
cierre_video: Keep the framing of the first frame. Grainy, wet, photographic. Not animated, not illustrated, not CGI-looking, not a video game.
solo_sonidos: the storm, the sea and the lamp mechanism

farero.descripcion: the lighthouse keeper: a heavy dark green rubberized rain coat with the hood ALWAYS up and low over the face, a thick grey knit sweater underneath, worn black rubber gloves, headlamp strapped over the hood — the face is NEVER visible, always shadow under the hood or seen from behind

exterior.descripcion: the lighthouse on its rock against the storm sea at night

escalera.descripcion: the spiral stone staircase inside the tower

sala.descripcion: the lamp room at the top: the giant fresnel lens and the bulb inside it

madre.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic photograph of an old white-and-red stone lighthouse on a black rock islet in a violent night storm, vertical frame. Huge waves exploding against the rocks, rain streaking sideways, low storm cloud. The lamp room at the top glows weak warm amber through its glass. A single steel door at the base, lit by one caged work light. No people, no boats. Film grain, deep blacks, wet surfaces shining. This is a single film frame, not a poster: no text, no borders, no titles, no watermark.

Photorealistic cinematic photograph looking straight DOWN the center of a spiral stone staircase inside an old lighthouse tower, vertical frame. Worn stone steps winding down into darkness, a black iron handrail, small round windows every few turns letting in blue lightning light and rain trails. Peeling white paint on the curved wall, a rope running along it. No people. Warm light from somewhere above, cold blue below. This is a single film frame, not a poster: no text, no borders, no titles, no watermark.

Photorealistic cinematic photograph of a lighthouse lamp room interior at night, vertical frame. The centerpiece: a tall FRESNEL LENS of concentric glass rings, taller than a person, and inside it one large incandescent lamp bulb glowing weak warm amber. Brass fittings, a small workbench with tools, storm rain streaking the wrap-around windows, lightning lighting the clouds outside. No people. This is a single film frame, not a poster: no text, no borders, no titles, no watermark.

Photorealistic character reference photograph, vertical frame, plain dark grey background, even soft lighting. A lighthouse keeper from the knees up: a heavy dark green rubberized rain coat shining wet, the hood UP and pulled low so the face is COMPLETELY hidden in shadow, a thick grey knit sweater collar showing at the neck, worn black rubber gloves, an elastic headlamp strapped over the hood, sturdy rubber boots. Neutral stance, facing camera, face entirely invisible under the hood. Every detail sharp and readable: this is the reference for every other shot. This is a single film frame, not a poster: no text, no borders, no titles, no watermark.

planos.funcion: HOOK. La lámpara vieja, débil, parpadeando: cuarenta años y se está muriendo.
planos.texto: la cambian a mano una vez al año
planos.ve: EXTREME CLOSE UP on a large old incandescent lighthouse bulb inside the concentric glass rings of a fresnel lens, filling the lower two thirds of the vertical frame. The filament glows a weak, tired amber. Rain streaks the dark window glass behind it, a flash of blue lightning far away. The upper third of the frame is dark glass and storm, kept clear.
planos.mueve: The filament flickers twice, dims almost to nothing, and recovers weakly. Rain intensifies on the glass behind. The blue of a lightning flash sweeps through the lens rings.
planos.audio: [SFX] a low electrical hum wavering with the flicker, a heavy relay ticking. [Ambient] storm rain on glass, wind pressing on the tower.

planos.funcion: PROMESA. El faro entero en la tormenta y el farero diminuto entrando con la lámpara nueva.
planos.ve: EXTREME WIDE SHOT of the lighthouse on its black rock in the night storm, towering in the vertical frame, waves exploding white against the base. The keeper in the dark green rain coat is a TINY figure at the base door — his full height about ONE TWELFTH of the image height — carrying a wooden crate, leaning into the wind. The lamp room glows weak amber at the top.
planos.mueve: A wave bursts against the rocks and the spray sweeps across the base. The tiny figure pushes the steel door open against the wind and slips inside with the crate. The amber glow at the top flickers once.
planos.audio: [SFX] a wave detonating on rock, close and huge. [Ambient] the full storm: wind, rain, the sea dragging back. [Foley] a heavy steel door slamming.

planos.funcion: BARRA DE PROGRESO. La escalera caracol desde arriba: el ojo sigue la subida, el contador va en post.
planos.ve: Looking straight DOWN the center of the spiral stone staircase, vertical frame, the steps winding down into darkness. Far below, the keeper climbs steadily — a small figure in the dark green coat, his headlamp beam sweeping the curved wall, the wooden crate under one arm. Blue lightning pulses through the small round windows.
planos.mueve: The keeper climbs turn after turn, his headlamp beam wiping across the peeling wall, boots landing heavy on the worn steps. The camera slowly descends toward him as he rises. Lightning pulses light the shaft twice.
planos.audio: [Foley] boots on stone, steady and effortful, breath inside a hood. [Ambient] the storm muffled by thick walls, wind moaning in the shaft.

planos.funcion: TENSIÓN. Se le apaga la linterna a mitad de subida: cambio de régimen de luz y sonido.
planos.ve: CLOSE UP on the keeper's gloved hand smacking the headlamp he has taken off, its beam flickering weakly, the spiral staircase behind him falling into darkness. His hooded head is bowed over the lamp, face completely in shadow. Rain trails run down a small round window beside him, lit blue by lightning.
planos.mueve: The headlamp flickers, dies, comes back for a heartbeat, and dies for good. Darkness takes the stairwell — only the round window stays faintly blue, and a lightning flash silhouettes the hooded figure. He pockets the dead lamp and keeps climbing by feel.
planos.audio: [Foley] a glove smacking plastic, twice. [SFX] the electrical whine of the lamp dying. [Ambient] the storm suddenly louder in the dark, as if closer.

planos.funcion: ESCALERA 1. Llega arriba: la sala y la lámpara casi muerta pulsando débil.
planos.ve: WIDE SHOT of the lamp room from the stair opening, vertical frame. The keeper in the wet green coat stands just inside, dripping, hood up, seen from behind. In front of him the tall fresnel lens towers to the ceiling, and inside it the old bulb pulses a weak, dying amber — the only light in the room. Storm rain streaks all the wrap-around windows.
planos.mueve: The bulb pulses slower and dimmer, and the room breathes with it: amber, dark, amber, dark. The keeper sets the wooden crate down without taking his eyes off the lamp. Rain lashes the windows harder.
planos.audio: [SFX] the electrical hum stuttering with each pulse. [Foley] a wooden crate set down on the floor, water dripping off a coat. [Ambient] the storm surrounding the glass room on all sides.

planos.funcion: ESCALERA 2 · ESCALA. La cúpula chiquita contra el mar negro enorme: lo que depende de esa lucecita.
planos.ve: EXTREME WIDE SHOT from high above the sea, vertical frame used at full height: the black storm ocean fills almost everything, waves long and white-veined, and in the lower part the lighthouse with its tiny weak amber lamp room — the whole tower about ONE EIGHTH of the image height. Lightning veins the clouds at the top of the frame. The amber glow is the only warm thing in a world of black water.
planos.mueve: A slow drift forward over the enormous sea toward the tiny lighthouse. The amber glow at its top flickers, almost dies, and holds. Lightning flashes twice and the whole sea surface flares white-blue and goes black again.
planos.audio: [Ambient] the open sea storm, huge and wide, thunder rolling long. [SFX] under it, very faint, the far hum of the struggling lamp.

planos.funcion: ESCALERA 3. El cambio: sale la vieja humeando de calor, entra la nueva, pesada, justa.
planos.ve: CLOSE UP inside the open fresnel lens housing, vertical frame. Two worn black rubber gloves hold the OLD bulb just lifted from its brass socket — its glass smoked dark, a thin wisp of heat-steam rising off it in the cold air. Below in the frame, resting in the open wooden crate, the NEW bulb: clean clear glass, heavy, waiting. Lightning light through the lens rings cuts both into blue slices.
planos.mueve: The gloves set the old bulb carefully into the crate, take up the new heavy bulb with visible effort, and lower it slowly into the brass socket, aligning it by feel — it settles in with one firm push. The heat-steam off the old bulb drifts and disappears.
planos.audio: [Foley] glass set on wood, gloves gripping, the heavy bulb seating into brass with a clunk. [SFX] the old bulb ticking as it cools. [Ambient] the storm on the glass, constant.

planos.funcion: GIRO. La enciende y... NADA. La sala queda negra: desaparece la luz y desaparece el zumbido.
planos.ve: WIDE SHOT of the lamp room, vertical frame: the keeper's silhouette stands at a brass switch panel beside the towering fresnel lens, hand on the lever, hood up, seen from the side. The room is lit ONLY by cold blue storm light through the rain-streaked windows — the lamp inside the lens is dark, dead glass. Everything warm is gone from the frame.
planos.mueve: He throws the lever. Nothing. The lens stays dark. He throws it again — nothing, and a lightning flash fills the room white-blue and drops it back into black. His hooded head turns slowly toward the dark lamp. Rain runs down all the windows.
planos.audio: [Foley] a heavy brass lever thrown, twice, dry clicks. [SFX] the electrical hum completely GONE — only silence where it was. [Ambient] the storm suddenly the loudest thing in the world.

planos.funcion: CONTACTO. A ciegas, a puro tacto: la rosca medio punto más, iluminado sólo por los rayos.
planos.ve: EXTREME CLOSE UP on the two rubber gloves back inside the lens housing, gripping the new bulb's base at the brass socket, in near-total darkness — the scene readable only in the strobing blue of lightning flashes through the glass rings. Rain shadows crawl over everything.
planos.mueve: The gloves twist the bulb's base a careful half-turn deeper into the socket, feeling for the seat. A pause — everything black between lightning flashes. Then one glove pats the glass once, gently, like luck.
planos.audio: [Foley] rubber gloves creaking on glass, brass threads turning, one soft pat. [Ambient] thunder close, rain hammering. [SFX] total electrical silence underneath.

planos.funcion: EL DETALLE, sostenido: el filamento despierta — de un hilito naranja a un resplandor blanco.
planos.ve: MACRO CLOSE UP on the dead filament inside the new bulb's clear glass, vertical frame, in blue storm darkness. The coiled filament is a thin grey thread. Beyond the glass, out of focus, the blurred rings of the fresnel lens and the rain-streaked window.
planos.mueve: The filament wakes: first one dull orange thread, creeping along the coil, then brightening through deep orange to yellow to a growing white glow that blooms and fills the whole frame with warm light. The blue storm world turns gold around it.
planos.audio: [SFX] the electrical hum returning — first a whisper, then rising, steady and healthy. [Ambient] the storm receding behind the growing hum.

planos.funcion: EL PAGO. Vuelta al encuadre del gancho: la misma lámpara, ahora a plena potencia, y el haz arranca a girar.
planos.ve: EXTREME CLOSE UP matching the first shot: the lighthouse bulb inside the fresnel lens rings filling the lower two thirds of the vertical frame — but now blazing FULL white-gold, hard light rays fanning through the concentric glass rings. The window behind still streaked with rain, the storm now lit by the beam. Upper third kept clear.
planos.mueve: The lens assembly begins to rotate slowly around the blazing bulb and the fanned rays sweep across the frame like spokes of light. Rain on the window flares gold every time a ray crosses it.
planos.audio: [SFX] the healthy hum now full, and the deep slow mechanical turn of the lens gears starting up. [Ambient] the storm still there, but beaten.

planos.funcion: CIERRE EN BUCLE. El haz barre el mar de tormenta y a lo lejos pasan las lucecitas de un barco. Corte a negro.
planos.ve: EXTREME WIDE SHOT of the lighthouse on its rock at night, vertical frame, the storm still heaving — but now a POWERFUL white beam sweeps out from the lamp room across the black sea, cutting through rain and spray. Far out near the horizon, the tiny running lights of a cargo ship, barely dots in the dark.
planos.mueve: The beam sweeps a slow full pass across the sea and catches the distant ship for an instant — its tiny lights blink on through the rain. The beam continues its turn, the storm rages on, and on the beam's next pass the frame cuts to black.
planos.audio: [Ambient] the storm and the sea, wide. [SFX] the slow rhythmic sweep of the beam, a distant fog horn answering once, then cut to silence.

voz.texto: Hoy la cambio yo. Con tormenta.
A mitad de subida se me apaga la linterna.
Sigo a oscuras hasta arriba. Y ahí está: casi muerta.
Abajo, en la tormenta, hay barcos que dependen de esta luz.
Saco la vieja todavía caliente. La nueva pesa veinte kilos.
La enciendo... y nada. Todo queda negro.
A ciegas, la giro medio punto más. Y pruebo otra vez.
Cuarenta años. Y esta noche también hay luz en el mar.
El año que viene subo de nuevo. ¿Vos subirías?
